reader_summary.headline: This is Jesse Pujji and today we’re breaking down The New York Times.
reader_summary.overview: This is Jesse Pujji and today we’re breaking down The New York Times. Since its founding in 1851. To underline that status, it has won 132 Pulitzer Prizes, almost double its nearest competitor. However, the business behind the Times hasn’t always been easy and it has faced several existential threats over its history.

key_points.text: However, the business behind the Times hasn’t always been easy and it has faced several existential threats over its history.
To break down The New York Times, I’m joined by Morning Brew co-founder and host of Founder’s Journal and Imposters podcasts, Alex Lieberman.
